description_en: Queries the list of nodes in a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用ListNodes查询指定集群中的节点列表
name: ListNodes

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster that you want to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the node. Valid values:
Manager: management node
Login: logon node
Compute: compute node
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型。取值范围：
Manager：管控节点
Login：登录节点
Compute：计算节点
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en: The name of the node. Fuzzy match is supported. MySQL regular expressions are supported
parameters.help_zh: 节点名称，支持模糊查询，支持MySQL的正则表达式
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数。取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of the node list. Valid values:
Forward: Ascending order.
Backward: Descending order.

Default value: Forward.

This parameter is used together with SortBy. For example, if SortBy is set to AddedTime and Sequence is set to Forward, nodes are sorted by the time when they were added to the cluster in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
节点列表排序方式。取值范围：
Forward：正序排序。
Backward：逆序排序。

默认值：Forward

和SortBy同时使用，如SortBy设置为AddedTime，Sequence设置为Forward，表示按节点加入时间正序查询
parameters.name: sequence

parameters.help_en:
The sorting method of the node list. Valid values:
AddedTime: sorted by the time when the node was added to the cluster.

HostName: sorted by the hostname of the node
parameters.help_zh:
节点列表排序方式。取值范围：
AddedTime：按加入时间排序

HostName：按节点主机名称排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The filter option for node status.

The value format is {"status":"node_status"}. Replace node_status with the status of the node. Valid values:

uninit: Installing.
exception: Abnormal.
running: Running.
initing: Initializing.
releasing: Releasing.
untracking: Not added to the cluster.
stopped: Stopped
parameters.help_zh:
节点状态过滤选项。

取值格式为：{"status":"node_status"}，请将其中node_status替换为节点的状态。节点的取值范围为：

uninit：安装中
exception：异常
running：运行中
initing：初始化中
releasing：释放中
untracking：未加入集群
stopped：已停止
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The hostname prefix. Queries nodes with the specified prefix
parameters.help_zh: 主机名前缀。查询具有指定前缀的节点
parameters.name: host_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: The hostname suffix. Queries nodes with the specified suffix
parameters.help_zh: 主机名后缀。查询具有指定后缀的节点
parameters.name: host_name_suffix

AddTime.description_en: The time when the node was added to the cluster. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone
AddTime.description_zh: 加入集群的时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时区

CreateMode.description_en:
The mode in which the node was created. Valid values:
manual: The node was manually scaled out.
autoscale: The node was automatically scaled out
CreateMode.description_zh:
节点创建方式。可能值：
manual：手动扩容
autoscale：自动扩容

CreatedByEhpc.description_en:
Indicates whether the node is created by E-HPC.

true: The node is created by E-HPC.

false: The node is not created by E-HPC
CreatedByEhpc.description_zh:
是否由E-HPC创建。

true：E-HPC创建

false：非E-HPC创建

Expired.description_en: Indicates whether the subscription node has expired. If the node uses the pay-as-you-go billing method, false is returned
Expired.description_zh: 包年包月付费节点是否到期。如果是按量付费节点，返回值为false

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the subscription node. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. If the node uses the pay-as-you-go billing method, an empty value is returned
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 包年包月付费节点到期时间，时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时区。如果是按量付费节点，返回值为空

ImageOwnerAlias.description_en:
The image type. Valid values:
system: public image.
self: custom image.
others: shared image.
marketplace: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image
ImageOwnerAlias.description_zh:
镜像类型。可能值：
system：公共镜像
self：自定义镜像
others：共享镜像
marketplace：镜像市场镜像

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type of the node

IpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the node

Location.description_en:
The location of the node. Valid values:
OnPremise: on-premises node.
PublicCloud: public cloud node
Location.description_zh:
节点所在位置。可能值：
OnPremise：本地节点
PublicCloud：公共云节点

LockReason.description_en:
The reason why the node is locked. Valid values:
financial: The node is locked due to overdue payment.
security: The node is locked for security reasons.
recycling: The spot instance is pending release.
dedicatedhostfinancial: The ECS instance is locked because the dedicated host has an overdue payment.

An empty string is returned by default
LockReason.description_zh:
节点被锁定类型。可能值：
financial：因欠费被锁定。
security：因安全原因被锁定。
recycling：抢占式实例的待释放锁定状态。
dedicatedhostfinancial：因为专有宿主机欠费导致ECS实例被锁定。

默认返回为空字符串

Role.description_en:
The type of the node. Valid values:
Scheduler: primary scheduler.
SchedulerBackup: secondary scheduler.
Account: primary domain server.
AccountBackup: secondary domain server.
Login: logon node.
Compute: compute node.

Schedulers and domain servers are management nodes
Role.description_zh:
节点类别。可能值：
Scheduler：主调度器
SchedulerBackup：备用调度器
Account：主域服务器
AccountBackup：备用域服务器
Login：登录节点
Compute：计算节点

调度器和域服务器都属于管控节点

items.description_en:
The type of the node. Valid values:
Scheduler: primary scheduler.
SchedulerBackup: secondary scheduler.
Account: primary domain server.
AccountBackup: secondary domain server.
Login: logon node.
Compute: compute node.

Schedulers and domain servers are management nodes
items.description_zh:
节点类别。可能值：
Scheduler：主调度器
SchedulerBackup：备用调度器
Account：主域服务器
AccountBackup：备用域服务器
Login：登录节点
Compute：计算节点

调度器和域服务器都属于管控节点

SpotStrategy.description_en: The bidding strategy of the compute node

StateInSched.description_en: The node status as viewed from the scheduler. The status varies depending on the scheduler
StateInSched.description_zh: 从调度器查看到的节点状态，不同调度器状态不同

Status.description_en:
The node status. Valid values:
uninit: Installing.
exception: Abnormal.
running: Running.
initing: Initializing.
releasing: Releasing.
untracking: Not added to the cluster.
stopped: Stopped
Status.description_zh:
节点状态。可能值：
uninit：安装中
exception：异常
running：运行中
initing：初始化中
releasing：释放中
untracking：未加入集群
stopped：已停止

TotalResources.description_en: The total resources used by the node
TotalResources.description_zh: 该节点使用的资源总量

Memory.description_en: The total memory resources. Unit: GB

UsedResources.description_en: The resource usage of the compute node. An empty value is returned for other types of nodes
UsedResources.description_zh: 计算节点资源使用量，其他类型节点返回值为空

Memory.description_en: The total memory resources. Unit: GB

Version.description_en: The version of the cluster client

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
